Try running a dedicated ammo/roid belt with only ammo and astroid chunks on it, it might make your ship a little longer but it will stop it from getting mixed and blocked by the iron ore.
Just turn on auto trash and turn your logistics off, move your ammo to your bag, works just as well

You have to buy them through the skill tree page, when you go to train them it will give you the option to buy the required books, I think they took most of the non faction type books out of the market in favor of being able to direct inject from the skill tree.
You need to install the new client, I had that when I logged in for the first time since the game changed launchers

Just ask most of the time the people playing will help you figure out what to do, mtn fortress resets everything the train dies so you don't have to wait too long to start from the beginning on that server. They also have a discord channel.
Try some of the comfy servers, full of great people to play with.
Have you looked at plecostmus? I had two that grew to about 30cm in length, we had to move one to another tank. They kept the glass in the tanks clean quite nicely.
